sessions.audience: All who wish to pass the PMI-PBA® certification exam and become a PMI® Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA®) are welcome to attend the training. The course is especially beneficial to Project Managers, Business Analysts Developers, QA Specialists and IT Professionals.

sessions.title: Enterprise Architecture
sessions.description: This course aims to present enterprise architecture concepts based on the newest TOGAF® 10 version in a practical way.
sessions.audience: This training is suitable for professionals who require basic to advanced knowledge of TOGAF and those who participate in Architecture projects and initiatives as well as those who are into development of Architecture artefacts.

sessions.title: Project Management Professional Preparation Course
sessions.description: Receive solid preparation for the PMP® exam by having a focused walk-through of the exam content and completing lots of practice tests joined by valuable group discussions.
sessions.audience: Anyone who is preparing for the PMP® exam. You can be at any stage of the preparation process. The best results are achieved if you have already started your preparation and plan to take the exam within 3 months of completing the training.
